description: Implement the Users microservice as a Node.js Express app wrapped for AWS Lambda. Includes full CRUD REST API, DynamoDB integration via AWS SDK v3, and package.json.
steps: Create services/users/app.js - Express app with routes: GET /users, GET /users/:id, POST /users, PUT /users/:id, DELETE /users/:id. Each route uses DynamoDB DocumentClient (table name from env var USERS_TABLE). User schema: { id (uuid), name, email, createdAt }.
Create services/users/handler.js - Lambda entry point that imports app.js and wraps it with @vendia/serverless-express. Export handler function.
Use crypto.randomUUID() for id generation (Node 18+ built-in, no extra dep needed).
Return proper HTTP status codes: 200 for GET/PUT, 201 for POST, 204 for DELETE, 404 when not found, 400 for missing required fields.
acceptance_criteria: services/users/package.json exists with all required dependencies listed
services/users/app.js exports an Express app with all 5 CRUD routes
services/users/handler.js exports a Lambda-compatible handler function
All routes interact with DynamoDB using AWS SDK v3 DocumentClient
No placeholder TODOs remain in core logic
verification: Read services/users/handler.js and confirm it exports a handler compatible with Lambda (exports.handler)
Read services/users/app.js and confirm all 5 routes are implemented with real DynamoDB logic
Read services/users/package.json and confirm @vendia/serverless-express and @aws-sdk/* deps are present
